name: wordpress-quiz
description: ## Introduction KDQuiz is a simple WordPress plugin designed to enhance user engagement through interactive quizzes. It allows users to craft their own questions and precisely control the display of quizzes on their website, ensuring a non-intrusive yet engaging experience for visitors.

scripts.build: sass assets/kd-quiz.scss assets/kd-quiz.min.css --style=compressed --source-map && sass assets/kd-admin-quiz.scss assets/kd-admin-quiz.min.css --style=compressed --source-map && terser assets/kd-quiz.js -c -m -o assets/kd-quiz.min.js && terser assets/kd-admin-quiz.js -c -m -o assets/kd-admin-quiz.min.js
